headline: Sensex drops 548 points, Nifty below 22,400 as oil prices spike and foreign funds exit

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Selling pressure in IT, FMCG, and financial sectors
Global cues including concerns over a US-Russia Diesel Deal
whatHappening: Sensex ended 548 points lower at the close of trading
Nifty 50 finished below the 22,400 mark at 22,363
Adani Enterprises began construction for the Dharavi rehabilitation housing project in Matunga
HCLTech reported record Q2 profits driven by rupee tailwinds despite a slip in its software segment
summary: The Indian stock market faced a sharp decline on Monday, with the Sensex falling 548 points and the Nifty closing below 22,400 due to rising oil prices and foreign fund outflows. Major sectoral laggards included IT and FMCG, with stocks like ITC and Tech Mahindra dropping 3% each. In contrast, HCLTech reported strong Q2 earnings and Adani Enterprises initiated construction on its major Dharavi housing project.
